subject: FoundryLaunch cohort — request for rate flexibility & extra early credits
messages:
From: Tamara Singh <tamara@foundrylaunch.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FoundryLaunch cohort — rate flexibility & early usage credits

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — we loved the demo last week. FoundryLaunch is running a new fall cohort (10 pre-seed/seed teams) and we’re trying to lock in partner credits and terms for the program by next Wednesday. Two asks from our side:

1) Can you provide a cohort-level blended rate (one invoice, bulk discount) for the 3-month pilot? A simple per-token cap or 20–30% discount would help us coordinate sponsor budgets.
2) We’d like an extra allotment of start-up credits (one-time) to seed each company’s sandbox usage for the first two weeks — roughly 50k tokens per team.

We realize this is an exception to standard starter bundles, but cohort timelines are tight and a confirmed partner package would get us to commit to Redwood prominently in the program. Happy to share a short MOA if that helps.

Can you confirm timeline for an approval or what information you need from us?

Thanks,
Tamara Singh
Program Lead, FoundryLaunch
Tamara@foundrylaunch.com
(415) 555-0219

Hi Tamara — great to hear from you and glad the demo landed well. Thanks for the clear asks; we can usually move on cohort packages but I need to confirm the numbers with finance and onboarding.

Quick read:
- Blended cohort rate: we can propose a 25% cohort discount off our starter list price for a 3-month pilot with a single invoice and a signed addendum.
- One-time sandbox credits: we can cover a 30k-token allotment per team as a promotion; increasing to 50k is possible with a partial commit (e.g., a small reserved capacity guarantee or a nominal onboarding fee).

I’ve looped in Ben (revenue approvals) and Lauren (onboarding). Ben — would a 25% cohort discount + 30k sandbox credits be OK to approve under our accelerator promo carve-out? If FoundryLaunch can sign the addendum and commit to running Redwood as the cohort default for the 3-month pilot we can extend 50k credits (subject to a simple one-page MOA).

Tamara — if you can send a quick headcount + projected peak monthly token usage per team, I’ll get a term sheet over by Thursday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Hi Tamara — thanks for the headcount and the expected peak usage spreadsheet — looks good. Per our internal approvals, Redwood is happy to confirm the following for the FoundryLaunch fall cohort: 

Summary of agreed terms (pilot):
- Cohort length: 3 months (pilot), single invoice to FoundryLaunch monthly.
- Discount: 25% off our starter price for cohort consumption (applies to token usage billed to FoundryLaunch).
- Sandbox credits: 50k tokens per team as a one-time allotment (10 teams = 500k tokens) — this is approved contingent on a signed MOA confirming FoundryLaunch will list Redwood as the cohort default provider during the pilot.
- Usage cap / guardrail: monthly soft cap of X tokens agreed in the addendum (we will align numbers based on your projected peak). Overages billed at standard list rate.

Attached: cohort_foundrylaunch_term_sheet.pdf (term sheet + MOA draft). Please review and indicate any edits. If this looks OK I’ll send a DocuSign for signatures and route to finance for the consolidated invoice setup.

Next steps:
1) Tamara to review & sign MOA (DocuSign link below)
2) Redwood to provision sandbox credits and schedule onboarding (Lauren will reach out to coordinate kickoff windows)
3) Finance will set up single invoice cadence and send payment instructions once MOA is signed.
